edits.find:
for (const dispose of disposers) {
          try { void dispose() } catch { /* a failed disposer must not mask the others */ }
edits.replace:
for (const dispose of disposers.slice(0, 0)) {
          try { void dispose() } catch { /* a failed disposer must not mask the others */ }

note: dispose must release every registered route; skipping the disposer leaves the first cycle mounted
